Tulip & Head Hardware

exchangeable in situ
Standard tulip. Ø12.5×14.9mm — lowest profile available. ELASTOLOK® locking mechanism. Ideal for young / slim patients.
Reduction tulip — Ø12.5×32.2mm, up to 17mm rod reduction, breakaway tabs. Also suits tissue-sparing Wiltse paraspinal access.

MIS tulip — available for percutaneous technique.

Tulips connect/disconnect with AC0010 (standard) or AC0011 (reduction) — removed & re-attached once only, then discard.
Double thread4.5mm displacement / turn — faster insertion
Self-tappingStrong purchase without pre-tap
Cannulated Ø1.9mmFrom Ø5.5mm · guide wire Ø1.8×252mm
AugmentableVertebroplasty cement, Ø5.5mm+, max 2ml/screw

Rods

Ø5.5mm
Straight, 500mm. Cobalt chrome (Art. AB1855-00500) or Titanium (Art. LSZ3000) — cut to length in theatre.
Curved, titanium. 30mm (AB0955-00030) & 125mm (AB0955-00125) — pre-contoured for sacro-iliac / long constructs.

Set Screw

T30 · self-retaining
Set screw, T30 drive. Art. AB0140-55000. Definitive tightening: SIGNUS T-handle + 11Nm torque limiter, to an audible double-click.

Connectors

sterile
Parallel connector. Ø5.5/5.5mm & Ø6.0/5.5mm — for subsequent, mixed-diameter treatment.
Extension sleeve. Ø5.5mm — extends an existing rod for staged / subsequent treatment.
Offset connector. Ø5.5mm — screw-to-rod / iliac fixation offset. L15 · L20 · L25 · L30mm.
Telescopic cross-connector. Rotational stability, torque-limited to 2.5Nm.

i

Augmentation. Augmentable screws (Ø5.5mm+) accept low-viscosity bone cement for vertebroplasty via the alignment cannula (AC0040). Max 2ml per screw — SIGNUS V-FIX Kyphoplasty Bone Cement recommended. Inject slowly under fluoroscopic control.

!

Never insert a DIPLOMAT pedicle screw without a tulip fitted — risk of driving the screw too deep. Each tulip may only be removed & re-attached once.

1Drill

Locate & penetrate the cortical bone with the pedicle awl (lumbar/thoracic). Confirm position, alignment & depth under fluoroscopy; read screw length from the awl markings. Guide wire + cannulated awl optional. Screws are self-tapping — cannulated/non-cannulated taps available if required.

Attaching the Screwdriver

1

The tip of the screwdriver must be inserted into the mating connection in the screw.

2

Push the sleeve of the screwdriver downwards and fix the screw by turning the screwdriver clockwise.

i

The line on the proximal screwdriver shaft shows when the screwdriver is firmly connected to the screw.

3

To loosen the screwdriver from the screw, turn the sleeve counter-clockwise until it detaches.

2Insertion of the pedicle screw

Click the tulip onto the screw — pull-test to confirm it's secure, then insert the assembled screw into the prepared tract. Confirm length & trajectory radiographically.

3Insertion of the rod

Select rod length; confirm lordosis/kyphosis with the bendable template. Place with the rod holder or persuader (more severe lordosis / repositioning); or use the rod fork for controlled repositioning into the tulip.

4Insertion of the set screws

Intermediate self-retaining set screwdriver through the counter-torque. Provisionally tighten every screw first to avoid cross-threading, before any distraction/compression manoeuvre.

5Distraction / compression

Fix a point; loosen the adjacent set screw a ¼ turn. Apply the modular parallel distractor (570500) or compressor (570501) with matched blades — valve pairs AB/BA/AD/BD/CD span 6–73mm.

6Final tightening

SIGNUS T-handle + 11Nm torque limiter through the counter-torque. Tighten to an audible click. Start caudal-left, proceed clockwise around the construct to systematically retighten all set screws.

7Cross-connectors

Measure rod spacing; attach with the 2.5Nm torque-limited driver + application sleeve. Tighten both outer screws first, centre screw last.

8Offset connectors — iliac

Prepare the ilium; insert the iliac screw to depth. Measure the offset, select the matching offset connector length (L15–L30), secure with the set screw + counter-torque.

i

OSIRION® I neuromonitoring. Continuous screw test during instrument guidance, plus a final check & documentation that each screw is correctly positioned with no nerve contact — traffic-light display.

!

Definitive tightening must use the SIGNUS T-handle with 11Nm torque limiter and the counter-torque — mechanical performance is only guaranteed at this torque.
